title: Watermarking Mixed PDF Pages? Check Portrait and Landscape
description: Check watermark placement, direction and readability on portrait and landscape PDF pages before sharing a new marked copy from your iPhone.
direct: Preview one portrait page and one landscape page before exporting a mixed PDF. Check the direction, size and readability of the mark on both.
figureAlt: Portrait and landscape document sheets need separate watermark-placement checks.
figureCaption: AI-generated conceptual illustration, not an App screenshot or measured export.
cards.decision.heading: Start with the decision
cards.decision.body: Page shape and page rotation are related but different. A PDF reader can display a rotated page upright while its internal coordinates differ. Do not assume a preview of the first page proves every later stamp is correctly placed.
sections.detail-0.heading: Check direction as well as presence
sections.detail-0.body: A watermark can exist on every page yet be difficult to read or badly placed on a wide table. Adobe’s watermark documentation treats scale, rotation and position as distinct appearance choices. That is a general PDF principle, not a claim that our app offers every Acrobat control or independent settings for each page.
sections.detail-1.heading: If the saved placement is wrong
sections.detail-1.body: Return to the original and try a shorter phrase or a different supported watermark style. If a page still exports incorrectly, preserve the original and the affected copy for support; do not send an unchecked document. It supports per-page previews and separate marked exports, but this article promises no repair of malformed rotation metadata. A visible watermark is not redaction or copy protection.
faqs.reader-question-1.heading: A mark is readable on tall pages but crosses a wide table. What can I try?
faqs.reader-question-1.body: Go back to the original and try shorter text or another supported style. Inspect the wide page again before sending.
faqs.reader-question-2.heading: Can watermarking correct a page that already opens sideways?
faqs.reader-question-2.body: Correct the source page orientation in an appropriate PDF editor first. Then add the watermark and check the saved orientation.

related.related.label: PDF Watermark Missing on Some Pages? Check the Export
steps.step-1.text: Keep the original. Open a copy in PDF Watermark & Stamp, enter the intended wording, and choose the supported repeated diagonal or centered style.
steps.step-2.text: Review a portrait page, a landscape page and any scanned or unusually sized page. Adjust available text size and opacity to keep tables, headings and signatures readable.
steps.step-3.text: Export a new PDF, reopen it outside the app and check those pages again. Confirm that the mark is present, readable and oriented usefully in the file you will send.
